grammarFocus: much / many / a little / a few；数量表达；should / should not。
title: Meal Planning for a Busy Week
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。请仔细阅读，答案必须来自短文。
passage:
Mei is a busy office worker in Shanghai. She wants to eat healthy food, but she has little time to cook. On Sunday, she plans her meals for the week. She checks her fridge. There is a little milk, a few eggs, and some vegetables. She needs to buy more food. She makes a shopping list. She writes: 'I should buy some rice, a few tomatoes, and a little chicken.' She also writes: 'I should not buy too many snacks.'

At the supermarket, Mei sees many people. She buys a lot of vegetables because they are good for her. She buys a few apples and a little cheese. She does not buy many cakes because they have much sugar. She says, 'I should eat a little sugar, not much.'

After shopping, Mei goes home. She cooks a simple dinner. She uses a few eggs and a little rice. She thinks, 'I should cook at home more often. I should not eat fast food many times a week.' She feels happy with her plan.

On Monday, Mei takes her lunch to work. She has a little salad and a few pieces of chicken. Her colleague, Tom, says, 'You should not eat so little. You need energy.' Mei answers, 'I have enough food. I also have a few nuts.' Tom says, 'That's good. You should drink much water, too.' Mei smiles and says, 'Yes, I should drink a lot of water.'

questions.prompt: What does Mei check on Sunday?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段提到“She checks her fridge.”，所以答案是“Her fridge”。

questions.prompt: What does Mei write on her shopping list?
options: I should buy some rice, a few tomatoes, and a little chicken.
I should buy a lot of cakes.
answers: I should buy some rice, a few tomatoes, and a little chicken.
questions.explanation: 第一段中Mei写道：“I should buy some rice, a few tomatoes, and a little chicken.”，所以选这个选项。
questions.evidence: She writes: 'I should buy some rice, a few tomatoes, and a little chicken.'

questions.prompt: Why does Mei not buy many cakes?
options: Because she does not like cakes.
questions.explanation: 第二段说“She does not buy many cakes because they have much sugar.”，所以原因是它们含糖多。
questions.evidence: She does not buy many cakes because they have much sugar.

questions.prompt: What does Mei have for lunch on Monday?
options: A little salad and a few pieces of chicken
A lot of rice and many eggs
A few cakes and a little milk
answers: A little salad and a few pieces of chicken
questions.explanation: 第四段提到“She has a little salad and a few pieces of chicken.”，所以选这个。
questions.evidence: She has a little salad and a few pieces of chicken.

questions.prompt: What does Tom say Mei should drink?
questions.explanation: Tom说：“You should drink much water, too.”，所以答案是“Much water”。
questions.evidence: You should drink much water, too.

questions.prompt: Mei buys a few ______ and a little cheese at the supermarket.
questions.explanation: 第二段说“She buys a few apples and a little cheese.”，所以填“apples”。
questions.evidence: She buys a few apples and a little cheese.

questions.prompt: Mei thinks she should not eat fast food ______ times a week.
questions.explanation: 第三段说“I should not eat fast food many times a week.”，所以填“many”。
questions.evidence: I should not eat fast food many times a week.

questions.prompt: Tom says Mei should not eat so little. Is this true?
questions.explanation: 第四段中Tom说：“You should not eat so little.”，所以这个说法是正确的。
questions.evidence: You should not eat so little.

questions.prompt: Mei buys many cakes at the supermarket. Is this true?
questions.explanation: 第二段说“She does not buy many cakes because they have much sugar.”，所以她并没有买很多蛋糕，这个说法是错误的。
questions.evidence: She does not buy many cakes because they have much sugar.

questions.prompt: Mei's colleague Tom is a good cook. Is this true?
questions.explanation: 短文没有提到Tom是否擅长烹饪。文中只说了Tom和Mei的对话，但没有关于他烹饪能力的信息，所以是Not Given。
questions.evidence: 文中没有提及Tom的烹饪能力。

She buys a lot of vegetables because they are good for her.
She buys a few apples and a little cheese.
Her colleague, Tom, says, 'You should not eat so little.'
I also have a few nuts.

grammar.title: Using much, many, a little, a few, and should
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，我们用“many”修饰可数名词的复数（如many cakes），用“much”修饰不可数名词（如much sugar）。 “a few”表示“一些”，修饰可数名词（如a few eggs）；“a little”也表示“一些”，但修饰不可数名词（如a little milk）。 “should”用来提建议，意思是“应该”，后面接动词原形；“should not”表示“不应该”。
grammar.example: She writes: 'I should buy some rice, a few tomatoes, and a little chicken.'

questions.prompt: I have ______ apples. Would you like one?
questions.explanation: apples是可数名词复数，表示“一些”用“a few”。

questions.prompt: There is ______ milk in the fridge. We don't need to buy any.
questions.explanation: milk是不可数名词，表示“一些”用“a little”。

questions.prompt: You ______ eat too many sweets. They are bad for your teeth.
questions.explanation: 表示“不应该”用“should not”，后面接动词原形。
questions.evidence: I should not buy too many snacks.

questions.prompt: How ______ sugar do you take in your tea?
questions.explanation: sugar是不可数名词，询问数量用“how much”。
questions.evidence: She does not buy many cakes because they have much sugar.
